title: Restore console issue type selector styling broken by shared newsroom selector CSS
description:
Problem: the Kanbus console's issue type selector (All / Initiatives / Epics / Issues / configured types, top bar) lost its styling. It renders in large, widely spaced body-size text with a boxy 6px-radius container instead of the compact 10px uppercase pill that matches the NOW / BOARD / WIKI / METRICS group beside it, and it overflows (labels clipped at the right edge). Screenshot of the live console on 0.36.0 shows it.

Cause: commit eb781a16 (2026-10-15, "share complete board interactions across console and hosts") moved the console onto the shared IssueTypeFilter (packages/ui/src/components/IssueTypeFilter.tsx), which wraps AnimatedSelector in .kb-type-filter-scroll and passes className "kb-type-filter". It also added UNSCOPED rules in packages/ui/src/styles/kanban.css (~lines 697-738): .kb-type-filter sets height auto, min-height 36px, padding 4px, border-radius 6px; .kb-type-filter button[role="tab"] sets font: inherit (which wipes AnimatedSelector's text-[10px] uppercase tracking), padding 4px 10px, min-height 32px, border-radius 4px; button[aria-selected="true"] paints its own background on top of AnimatedSelector's animated .selector-highlight. These were meant for embedded newsroom hosts but apply to every host, including the console. The newsprint theme (packages/ui/src/styles/newsprint.css:89-91) already scopes its look under [data-kanbus-theme="newsprint"], building on those base rules.

Fix (the right way, no per-host hacks in the console):
1. In kanban.css keep only the unscoped rules needed for layout: .kb-type-filter-scroll (min-width 0, max-width 100%, overflow-x auto, flex-shrink 1, plus hidden scrollbar if the console design hides it) and on .kb-type-filter only width max-content and max-width none. Remove every rule that changes the selector's visual design (font, padding, heights, radius, background, selected background) so the default look is AnimatedSelector's own, identical to the other console selectors.
2. Move whatever appearance the newsroom (newsprint) theme needs into newsprint.css under [data-kanbus-theme="newsprint"], so the newsprint selector looks exactly as it does today (font size and family, padding, heights, selected state). Check packages/ui/src/styles/organizer.css and ORGANIZER.md for any host theme that relied on the base rules and scope it the same way.
3. Do not change the option set or selector semantics in this ticket.
4. Verify visually with before/after screenshots (headless Chrome works on this Mac: "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless=new --window-size=1600,900 --virtual-time-budget=15000 --screenshot=<file> <url>): (a) the console in default theme, light and dark, showing the selector matches the NOW/BOARD group and scrolls instead of clipping; (b) the newsprint board story (packages/ui/src/stories/NewsprintBoard.stories.tsx) unchanged versus before; (c) AnimatedSelector stories unchanged. Put the screenshots in the PR description (upload as PR comment images or attach paths) and report their file paths.
5. Run packages/ui tests (npm test or the cucumber suite in packages/ui/features) and the console build; follow repo practice for rust/embedded_assets/console (check whether recent console PRs update it; CI rebuilds before packaging). Note in the PR that @kanbus/ui needs a patch release (ui-v tag) for Papyrus hosts to pick up the change.

Acceptance: console selector visually matches the adjacent NOW/BOARD selector (10px uppercase, pill, animated highlight, no extra selected background); no clipping; newsprint theme pixel-equivalent to before; ui tests pass.
